They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234. We might need to book a flight. But they didn't specify card id. We might need to get credit cards. But the user just wants estimated total payable amount. So we can compute flight cost. But maybe also insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to. We need to get list of airports. So call list_all_airports. Then pick first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. Also maybe we need to confirm booking ID 1234 exists? But not necessary.

Thus steps:

1. Call list_all_airports to get list. 
2. Determine first and last airport codes. 
3. Call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date="2024-10-31", travel_class="business". 
4. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We don't have to book yet. Just estimate.

Let's do that.
